definitions.full: H7406. rekes [ רֶ֫כֶס ] noun [masculine] dubious; perhaps roughness (of ground; ? literally binding, knot ); or bound up, impeded, i.e. the impassable ; or mountain- chain (see Thes); — plural הָֽרְכָסִים Isa 40:4 (|| הֶעָקֹכ ; opposed to בִּקְעָה ).
